overall.summary: The spec-complete app of the trio: 34-city catalog, both modes, DST-correct live overlap (2 hours in September PDT/CEST), 20 passing tests, and a real desktop/mobile layout split. Harness status is failed only because the session was SIGINT'd after the app already built and served.

standards.summary: 1,661 lines across a typed catalog, overlap/timezone modules, Zustand persist, and two dedicated grid components. Twenty Vitest cases cover overnight windows, fractional offsets, and both modes.

findings.title: Both grids stay in the accessibility tree
findings.detail: Desktop and mobile layouts are toggled with hidden/md:block. The browser snapshot still exposes both grids to AT, so every hour is announced twice. Prefer hidden or inert on the unused layout, not only a CSS display class.

strengths: 20 tests: isAwake, exclusive-end ranges, midnight wrap, India/Nepal offsets, meeting vs base
City catalog is a typed data module with accent-insensitive search
localStorage persist with merge that drops stale city ids
pnpm-only Vite app on the allocated port 9321

specification.summary: Every requirement of the brief is met. Live DST on 2026-09-02 yields 2 overlap hours (7–8am and 10–11pm SF) instead of the January fixture's single 10pm hour, which is the correct current-date result.
strengths: Defaults: SF, Denpasar, Geneva, meeting mode, 7am–11pm, 12-hour format
34 catalog cities across all seven required regions; add/remove; no duplicates
Reference promotion, Base-mode per-city ranges, inclusive-start exclusive-end badges
Hint text: Green cells = everyone awake; title and heading are Claude Fable 5.1

ux.summary: The grid makes the two DST overlap columns instantly obvious, each cell has an aria-label, and Base mode rewrites the summary per city without losing alignment.

findings.title: Overlap is still mostly colour plus weight
findings.detail: Overlap cells add a mint inset ring, which is better than fill alone, but colour-vision users still lean on weight. A second non-colour cue (dot or hatch) would survive a greyscale pass.

strengths: Now-column marker on the current SF hour
Fractional minutes stacked on a second line so India/Nepal never overflow
Click-a-city-to-promote hint next to the city count
Settings panel and searchable city picker are keyboard-reachable
